name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: Gazlowe in Ratchet still waits for the fuel regulator he promised Pozzik. Revilgaz in Booty Bay said he would ship it, but it has not arrived. So Gazlowe sends you to Wharfmaster Lozgil at the far northwestern end of the Booty Bay docks to check the cargo records.

sections.title: A Part That Never Came
sections.body: Gazlowe promised Pozzik a new fuel regulator, but it has not reached Ratchet. Revilgaz in Booty Bay said he would ship it over. Perhaps the part slipped through the cracks. If it never left, there may be little to do. Still, you can find out whether it departed Booty Bay. Wharfmaster Lozgil, at the far northwestern end of the docks, can search the cargo records.

sections.title: The Wharfmaster's Records
sections.body: Wharfmaster Lozgil checks the logbooks for shipments to Ratchet. The latest entry is boots from Drizzlik. Earlier shipments carried building supplies and tools. No race parts appear in the records.

faq.answer: Gazlowe promised Pozzik a new fuel regulator, but it has not reached Gazlowe in Ratchet.

faq.q: Who said they would send the regulator to Ratchet?
faq.answer: Revilgaz in Booty Bay said he would ship the regulator to Gazlowe in Ratchet.

faq.q: Who keeps the shipping records in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Lozgil keeps the shipping records in Booty Bay. He is at the far northwestern end of the Booty Bay docks.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows the first Goblin Sponsorship, when Pozzik sent you to Gazlowe. The next step is Goblin Sponsorship 3.
